1use super::Object;
2use crate::third_party::lopdf::Result;
3use crate::third_party::lopdf::writer::Writer;
4use std::io::Write;
5
6#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
7pub struct Operation {
8    pub operator: String,
9    pub operands: Vec<Object>,
10}
11
12impl Operation {
13    pub fn new(operator: &str, operands: Vec<Object>) -> Operation {
14        Operation { operator: operator.to_string(), operands }
15    }
16}
17
18#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
19pub struct Content<Operations: AsRef<[Operation]> = Vec<Operation>> {
20    pub operations: Operations,
21}
22
23impl<Operations: AsRef<[Operation]>> Content<Operations> {
24    /// Encode content operations.
25    pub fn encode(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
26        let mut buffer = Vec::new();
27        let mut first_operation = true;
28        for operation in self.operations.as_ref() {
29            // Add new line after each operation except the last one.
30            if first_operation {
31                first_operation = false;
32            } else {
33                buffer.write_all(b"\n")?;
34            }
35            for operand in &operation.operands {
36                Writer::write_object(&mut buffer, operand)?;
37                buffer.write_all(b" ")?;
38            }
39            buffer.write_all(operation.operator.as_bytes())?;
40        }
41        Ok(buffer)
42    }
43}
